stock.description: Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, primarily overseeing and managing a substantial chain of restaurants. Its expansive network consists of 217 dining establishments strategically located throughout Hong Kong, Mainland China, Macau, and Taiwan. These operate under a diverse portfolio of brand names, including Tai Hing, TeaWood, Trusty Congee King, Men Wah Bing Teng, Phở Lộ, Tokyo Tsukiji, Fisher & Farmer, Rice Rule, Hot Pot Couple, King Fong Bing Teng, Asam Chicken Rice, Dao Cheng, Winter Joy, White Little, and Dimpot. The company was established in 1989 and its principal headquarters are situated in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong. Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Chun Fat Company Limited.
